violated_contract: A filtered view must decide whether a filter is active from the filter's selection, never from whether the filter's result set is empty. Using `!results.isEmpty` as the test for an applied filter turns a legitimate zero-match result into the unfiltered list, so the view shows every item under an active filter chip instead of an honest empty state.
canonical_prevention: Branch on the selection state (for example `!selectedTags.isEmpty`) and let an empty result render the no-results state. Prove it with a hermetic test that selects a filter with no matches against a populated list and asserts the visible list is empty, plus a control that a filter with matches shows only those items.
